title: Two-Tier Vehicle I/O Timeout Policy (Parked vs Active Maneuver)

tier1_parked_connection.context: Initial Pleos Vehicle SDK / AAOS CarPropertyManager binding and capability lookup while parked in P

tier2_active_maneuver.context: Active turn-signal practice, steering practice, parking maneuver, and real-time driving situation coaching

assertions: Initial GET or first subscription snapshot (isInitial=true) never completes a practice step
Stale signal exceeding freshness threshold interrupts active practice safely without false completion
VoiceCoach never queues delayed TTS prompts after timeout or audio-focus loss
